statement: ∀ (F : Module.End ℂ V) (s : Reduction.loc p) (z : V), F (s • z) = s • F z
proof:
intro F s z
change F ((algebraMap (Reduction.loc p) ℂ s) • z) = (algebraMap (Reduction.loc p) ℂ s) • F z
exact F.map_smul _ _
